name: Side-Lying Lat Stretch
steps: Lie on your side with your knees bent beside a sturdy chair placed beyond your head.
Reach your top arm overhead and hold the near edge of the seat.
Gently shift your top hip away from your hand until you feel a stretch along your side.
Hold while breathing evenly, then release the seat and switch sides.
tips: Choose a chair that stays firmly in place under light pressure.
Keep your ribs facing forward as you lengthen your side.
